# What's Included in a Deep Clean in Cape Town? (Clear Scope Checklist)

**Deep cleaning** buys **dwell time** where soil hides: kitchens, wet rooms, edges, and built-up film. It is not “standard cleaning, but slower” unless your provider says so—and at Shalean, **tier and tick boxes** define the job before anyone arrives.

This article is the **scope layer** in your cluster: it pairs with [**which cleaning tier to book**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town) (decision) and [**same-day cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town) (urgency). It does **not** replace live line items—always confirm your selections in the booking flow.

---

## Quick answer: what is included in deep cleaning?

**Deep cleaning** usually includes **extra time** on kitchens and bathrooms, **more detail** on edges and fixtures, and **heavier dust removal** than a maintenance visit. **Oven interiors, inside fridges, walls, and decluttering** are often **add-ons or separate scope**—not assumed. Your checklist should match what you tick at booking.

---

## Usually included vs typical add-ons (at a glance)

Exact line items follow your booking selections; this table orients expectations before you compare totals on [**cleaning prices in Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/cleaning-prices-cape-town).

| Area / task | Usually in deep baseline | Often an add-on or special note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kitchen counters, hob, sink, splashbacks | Yes (heavier degrease passes) | — |
| Cupboard fronts & drawer fronts (exterior) | Usually yes | — |
| Microwave interior | Often yes on deep | Sometimes add-on—confirm |
| Oven interior (degrease) | Often **add-on** | Select if needed |
| Fridge interior | Often **add-on** | Select if needed |
| Inside all kitchen cupboards | Usually **not** default | Ask / scoped |
| Bathrooms: toilet, basin, shower/bath | Yes (more dwell on tracks, screens) | — |
| Grout brushing / heavy limescale | More time than standard | Severe cases may need specialist |
| Skirting, door frames, switches | Usually yes (reachable) | Very high areas may be limited |
| Floors: vacuum + mop | Yes | Heavy stain removal ≠ guaranteed |
| Windows (full panes inside) | Varies by provider | Often separate service |
| Wall washing (full rooms) | **Not** default deep | Separate scope |

---

## Kitchen (where deep cleaning earns its minutes)

Kitchens are the highest ROI zone in most Cape Town homes—coastal dust plus cooking film stacks fast.

**Typically emphasised on deep:**

- Degrease and polish hob, counters, and backsplashes
- Sink, taps, and drain area detail
- Appliance **exteriors** (fridge, dishwasher, oven door)
- Cupboard and drawer **fronts**
- Bin area and kickboards
- Light switches and handles in the kitchen run

**Often add-on or explicitly selected:**

- **Oven interior** deep degrease
- **Fridge interior** empty-and-clean
- Inside cupboards (requires emptying first)

---

## Bathrooms (second critical zone)

**Typically emphasised on deep:**

- Toilet full sanitise, including exterior and base
- Basin, taps, mirror, vanity fronts
- Shower/bath: screens, tracks, tiles at eye level and below
- Shelving and recess dusting where reachable
- Floor corners and behind-door edges

**Boundary:** silicone replacement, regrouting, and heavy mould remediation are **not** “a bit more scrubbing”—they are often **specialist** jobs.

---

## Living areas & bedrooms

**Usually included (reachable):**

- Dusting surfaces, media units, shelves (where accessible without moving heavy furniture)
- Skirting boards and door frames
- Light switches and power points (careful damp wipe)
- Vacuum under beds **if** there is clearance; otherwise edges
- Floors vacuumed and mopped as applicable

**Usually not assumed:**

- Moving heavy furniture without a prior agreement
- Washing curtains or dry-cleaning upholstery
- Cleaning inside wardrobes unless scoped and emptied

---

## Hallways, entrances, and laundry

- Dusting, cobweb removal (reachable), floor care
- Laundry sink and appliances (exterior wipe) when in scope

Coastal homes in **Sea Point**, **Green Point**, or wind-exposed **Constantia** edges often show extra dust in entrances—deep visits spend time there when selected in scope.

---

## What deep cleaning usually does **not** include

Short boundary list—reduces mismatched bookings and protects distinction from **same-day** and **move-out** intent:

- **Decluttering or organising** your belongings
- **Post-renovation builder’s clean** (fine trade dust everywhere) unless booked as that scope
- **Carpet steam extraction** unless carpet work is selected / offered
- **Exterior windows**, high ladders, or roof gutters
- **Pest control, sewage, biohazard**
- **Restoration** (fire/flood) level recovery

If you need **urgency**, read [**same-day cleaning in Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town)—it explains **calendar** fit, not automatic inclusion of everything above.

---

3. Use [**cleaning prices in Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/cleaning-prices-cape-town) for band context, then return to confirm.

### Mid-article CTA

Ready to match checklist to checkout? Start on [**deep cleaning services**](https://shalean.co.za/services/deep-cleaning-cape-town) and add oven/fridge only if you actually need them—your total should reflect real labour, not guesswork.

---

## Frequently asked questions

### Is oven cleaning included in a deep clean?

Often as an **add-on** you must select. Exterior degrease may be in deep; **interior** oven degrease usually needs explicit scope.

### Does deep cleaning include inside the fridge?

Usually only if you select it and the fridge is emptied. Do not assume it is bundled.

### Does deep cleaning include walls?

Not by default. Spot marks sometimes; **full wall washing** is separate scope.

### Will cleaners move furniture?

Light movement within reason for safety; heavy lifting or reorganising is not assumed—note priorities instead.

### How is deep different from standard in one sentence?

Deep buys **more time on edges and wet rooms**; standard maintains a fair baseline on a leaner clock.

### Does deep cleaning remove mould?

Light surface mould may improve cosmetically; active mould problems need **remediation**, not a residential deep tick box.

### How long does a deep clean take?

Longer than standard for the same home—often materially so—because kitchens and baths receive more dwell. See the time discussion in the [**which to book**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town) pillar.

### Can I book deep cleaning same-day?

Sometimes, for realistic scope—read [**same-day cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town). Large resets may need a scheduled day.

---
